add_plan.description: Leave both temperatures empty for the plan that applies whenever no other plan matches. Set only the lower bound for a warm-weather plan, only the upper bound for a cold-weather plan, or both to limit the plan to a band.

plan_options.description: Leave both temperatures empty for the plan that applies whenever no other plan matches. Set only the lower bound for a warm-weather plan, only the upper bound for a cold-weather plan, or both to limit the plan to a band.

link_schedule.title: Link a schedule helper
link_schedule.description: Link a schedule helper to a climate entity for a plan. Clearing the helper unlinks it; the helper itself is never deleted.

plan_selection.title: How the active plan is chosen
plan_selection.description: A plan keeps its band until the reading leaves it by half the hysteresis, and the reading must hold for the sustain window before the plan switches.

data.mode: How the active plan is chosen

visibility.title: Wrapped entities
visibility.description: Each climate entity in this room is mirrored by a Scheduled Climate entity. Hiding the original keeps each thermostat from appearing twice in pickers, voice assistants and auto-generated dashboards. Hiding only affects the user interface: automations, scripts, history and the APIs keep using the original entity.

schedule_not_linked.title: Scheduled Climate needs a schedule helper
schedule_not_linked.description: {name} used the old daily on and off times. Create a schedule helper with your desired blocks and link it from the Scheduled Climate card or the integration options.

schedule_missing.title: Linked schedule helper is missing
schedule_missing.description: {name} is linked to {entity_id}, which no longer exists. Link a different schedule helper from the integration options.

block_unsupported.description: The active schedule block for {name} could not be fully applied: {issues}

outdoor_sensor_unavailable.title: Outdoor temperature sensor is unavailable
outdoor_sensor_unavailable.description: {name} cannot read {entity_id}. The plan will not switch automatically until the sensor reports a number again, and the last plan stays in force.

no_plans.title: Room has no plans
no_plans.description: {name} has no plans, so nothing is scheduled. Add a plan from the integration options.
